items.title: 32.4 Viral infections ke ilaj ki mushkilat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of challenges in treating viral infections (PDF 236).

blocks.text: Viral infections ka ilaj bacterial infections se bunyadi taur par mukhtalif hai. Bacteria khud-mukhtar jandaar hain, jab ke viruses parasites hain jo akele sahi maanon mein zinda nahi: yeh hamare cells ke andar rehte aur apni nasal barhane ke liye hamari DNA/RNA machinery use karte hain. Is liye aisi dawa banana mushkil hai jo virus maare magar hamare sehatmand cells ko nuqsan na de.

blocks.title: Mutation
blocks.text: Viruses apna genetic maddah bohat tezi se badal sakte hain; ise mutation kehte hain. Jo dawa aik saal virus ke khilaf kaam kare, agle saal shayad na kare, kyunke virus badal chuka hota hai. Isi liye flu ki vaccines har saal update karni parti hain.

Kuch viruses hamare genome mein shamil ho jate ya hamare cells mein saalon tak ghair-faal ('soye hue') rehte hain, aur maujooda dawayein sirf faal viruses ko maar sakti hain. Antiviral dawayein virus ki zindagi ke khaas marahil ko nishana banati hain: kuch virus ko hamare cells mein dakhil hone se rokti hain, jab ke kuch virus ko apna genetic maddah copy karne se rokti hain. Sab se aam tareeqon mein se aik enzyme inhibition hai. Maslan protease inhibitors HIV aur hepatitis C ke ilaj mein use hote hain. Kuch antiviral dawayein is ke bajaye immune radd-e-amal ko taqwiyat deti hain; interferons aise proteins hain jo viruses se larne ke liye immune system ko mazboot karte hain.

blocks.title: Protease inhibitors kya rokte hain
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke protease inhibitor 'virus ko aik lambi lari mein protein banane nahi deta'. Asal mein virus apne proteins aik lambi lari ki shakal mein banata hai, aur us ka protease enzyme is lari ko kaam ke proteins mein kaat'ta hai; protease inhibitors yeh kaatna rokte hain, is liye naye viruses mukammal nahi ho pate.

blocks.alt: Chaar qadam baen se daen: virus cell mein dakhil, genetic maddah ki copy, lambi protein lari protease se kat'ti, naye viruses bahar. Pehle teen qadmon ke neeche surkh X ke saath dawaon ke khane: entry blockers, copying blockers, protease inhibitors.
blocks.caption: Antiviral dawayein virus ki zindagi ke kis qadam par asar karti hain (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Dawa A ka TI 3 aur dawa B ka TI 50 hai. Kaun si zyada mehfooz hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Dawa B: is ki zehreeli khurak mo'assar khurak se 50 guna hai, jo dawa A se kaheen zyada hifazati gunjaish hai.

blocks.prompt: Magnesium hydroxide jaise antacids medah ka pH kaise qaboo karte hain? Neutralisation equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: Base medah ka zyada tezab neutralise kar ke pH barhata hai: Mg(OH)2 + 2HCl -> MgCl2 + 2H2O.

blocks.prompt: Penicillin mein woh tanao wali ring pehchanein jo is ke antibacterial asar ke liye zaruri hai.
blocks.explanation: Chaar rukni beta-lactam ring (thiazolidine ring se juri).

blocks.prompt: Morphine aur codeine (methylmorphine) ki banawat ka muqabla karein. Yeh chhota farq codeine ke prodrug hone se kaise jura hai?
blocks.explanation: Codeine woh morphine hai jis ka aik OH group (phenolic OH) OCH3 mein badla hai. Is se codeine opioid receptors se kamzor jurti hai; jigar mein kuch codeine se methyl hat kar woh morphine ban jati hai, jo zyada tar dard door karti hai, is liye codeine prodrug hai.

blocks.prompt: Bohat si antiviral dawayein mareez ke liye numayan side effects kyun deti hain?
blocks.explanation: Viruses mezban cell ki apni machinery se nasal barhate hain, is liye virus ki nasal-kashi rokne wali dawayein mareez ke sehatmand cells mein bhi mudakhlat kar sakti hain.

items: Viruses hamare cells mein reh kar hamari machinery use karte; tezi se badalte.
Antivirals dakhla, genetic maddah ki copy ya protein ki tayyari (protease inhibitors) rokte.
